name: orillacart
description: OrillaCart admin screens and development environment.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build settings=./assets/admin/settings/index.tsx tax=./assets/admin/tax/index.tsx attribute-sets=./assets/admin/attribute-sets/index.tsx stockrooms=./assets/admin/stockrooms/index.tsx stock=./assets/admin/stock/index.tsx product-editor=./assets/admin/product-editor/index.tsx shipping=./assets/admin/shipping/index.tsx payments=./assets/admin/payments/index.tsx orders=./assets/admin/orders/index.tsx customers=./assets/admin/customers/index.tsx emails=./assets/admin/emails/index.tsx exchange=./assets/admin/exchange/index.tsx coupons=./assets/admin/coupons/index.tsx price-rules=./assets/admin/price-rules/index.tsx jobs=./assets/admin/jobs/index.tsx reports=./assets/admin/reports/index.tsx blocks=./assets/admin/blocks/index.tsx dataviews=./assets/admin/dataviews/index.ts --output-path=build/admin && wp-scripts build storefront=./assets/storefront/index.ts --output-path=build/storefront
scripts.start: wp-scripts start settings=./assets/admin/settings/index.tsx tax=./assets/admin/tax/index.tsx attribute-sets=./assets/admin/attribute-sets/index.tsx stockrooms=./assets/admin/stockrooms/index.tsx stock=./assets/admin/stock/index.tsx product-editor=./assets/admin/product-editor/index.tsx shipping=./assets/admin/shipping/index.tsx payments=./assets/admin/payments/index.tsx orders=./assets/admin/orders/index.tsx customers=./assets/admin/customers/index.tsx emails=./assets/admin/emails/index.tsx exchange=./assets/admin/exchange/index.tsx coupons=./assets/admin/coupons/index.tsx price-rules=./assets/admin/price-rules/index.tsx jobs=./assets/admin/jobs/index.tsx reports=./assets/admin/reports/index.tsx blocks=./assets/admin/blocks/index.tsx dataviews=./assets/admin/dataviews/index.ts --output-path=build/admin
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets tests/e2e playwright.config.js webpack.config.js
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/orillacart env ORILLACART_WP_LOAD=/var/www/html/wp-load.php vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration
scripts.test:opensearch: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/orillacart env ORILLACART_WP_LOAD=/var/www/html/wp-load.php ORILLACART_OPENSEARCH=http://oc-opensearch:9200 vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite integration --filter OpenSearch
scripts.demo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/orillacart wp eval-file bin/demo-shop.php && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/orillacart wp orillacart jobs work
scripts.db:diff: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/orillacart wp eval-file bin/make-migration.php
